about.q1: What does Huanan Fire Prevention do?
about.a1: A manufacturer and engineering service provider focused on fire-rated doors, windows and glass systems, founded in 2020 in Daojiao Town, Dongguan.
about.a1b1: Products: aluminum fire-rated windows (110/120/125 series), steel fire-rated windows (Class A/B/C), fire-resistant curtain walls, fire glass partitions
about.a1b2: Fire glass: composite heat-insulating (Class A), nano crystal silicon (Class C), borosilicate, monolithic cesium-potassium
about.a1b3: Services: production, OEM cooperation, turnkey installation
about.a2: Two integrated production systems: fire-rated doors/windows and fire glass processing, ensuring stable supply.
about.a2b1: Fire doors & windows: frame production + deep processing full flow
about.a2b2: Fire glass: cutting, edging, tempering, insulating, laminating lines
about.q3: What is the upstream supply chain?
about.a3: Affiliated companies supply base glass; upstream cooperation ensures Low-E raw glass supply.
about.a3b1: Guangdong Huanan New Materials: CSG & Xinyi offline Low-E franchisee, Yaopi online Low-E Guangdong general agent
about.a3b2: Dongguan Xinyijia Glass: tempering, insulating, laminating, Low-E, fire glass base processing
about.a3b3: System: one-to-one service ensuring stable production and supply
about.a4: Based in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, serving public and commercial buildings nationwide.
about.a4b1: Types: exhibition centers, schools, hospitals, offices, commercial complexes, residences
about.a4b2: Cases: CIFI Zhongjun World City, Foshan Yongjingtai, Haifeng Cultural Town, etc. (see project cases page)
cases.faq.title: FAQ
cases.faq.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about fire-rated window/curtain wall projects
cases.faq.q1: What verifiable projects has Huanan Fire Prevention completed?
cases.faq.a1: Representative cases: Heyuan CIFI Zhongjun World City (glass curtain wall ~1,740 sqm, 6mm Low-E insulated tempered glass, completed 2020), CIFI Foshan Yongjingtai (~156,853 sqm total), Haifeng Hongcheng Cultural Town (~1,216 sqm curtain wall), Luhu poverty-relief factory (50-series casement windows ~1,452 sqm, 2019). See cases on this page.
cases.faq.q2: How to choose fire-rated window classes A, B or C?
cases.faq.a2: Per GB 16809: Class A 1.50h, Class B 1.00h, Class C 0.50h. Select by fire compartment requirement: Class A for escape routes (stairwells, elevator lobbies); Class B for ordinary fire separation; Class C for auxiliary openings.
cases.faq.q3: What glass configurations are used for curtain walls and windows?
cases.faq.a3: Common: 6mm Low-E + 12mmA + 6mm insulated tempered (curtain walls), 6mm clear + 0.76PVB + 6mm laminated tempered (railings, canopies), 5mm tempered (standard windows). Fire-rated areas require Class A or C fire glass.
